entries.title: Direct Insult
entries.description: A literal insult against religion or its sanctities.

entries.title: Indirect Mockery
entries.description: An implied or coded mockery that still clearly targets religion.

entries.title: Desecration
entries.description: A literal act or statement showing desecration of a sacred object or place.

entries.title: Symbols
entries.description: A visible symbol or sacred marker used in a harmful way.

entries.title: Sectarian Language
entries.description: Language that divides communities or creates hostility.

entries.title: Historical Reference
entries.description: A historical reference that is descriptive rather than endorsing.

entries.title: Academic Discussion
entries.description: A scholarly explanation with no endorsement.

entries.title: Quotation
entries.description: A quoted line rather than direct endorsement.

entries.title: Condemnation
entries.description: A line explicitly rejecting harmful content.

entries.title: Contextual Support
entries.description: Surrounding context that clarifies the religious meaning.
